reason: Basics stay free and it's a one-time $4.99, no subscription, so it's less annoying than every other ADHD app. If the pet still sticks after a week I'd grab the Start Kit for the lock-screen widget, because that's what actually helps me start.
objection: I abandon apps after two weeks, so I might pay and then never open it again. Also the single packs add up to $5.97, so the bundle is the only sensible option.
would_change_my_mind: If the lock-screen widget were locked behind a pack I'd feel it's a basic, not a bonus. Nothing else would stop me.
